items.title: Meta is in need of a new 'lead singer' beyond advertising: Brent Thill
items.summary: Meta Platforms (META) stock is down by over 9% on Thursday since the tech giant released quarterly results that missed adjusted earnings estimates while raising the lower end of its full-year capital expenditures. Jefferies senior analyst Brent Thill highlights Meta's various revenue segments and why the Big Tech name needs to look beyond just its core advertising business.
